legend.notes: Sentences quoted verbatim from the catalog page that state a condition we could NOT express as structure — exclusions ("Research courses may not be used"), eligibility lists, per-course grade minimums. A section can consist of nothing but these. Quote them; never infer from them that a particular course does or does not satisfy the section.
legend.creditsRequired: Semester hours the catalog states for a section whose courses it does not list. Do not add these into a program total: some restate credit that another section already counts.

requirementSections.title: Integrating Classroom and Professional Experiences
notes: Learning by doing is a hallmark of a Northeastern MBA. Students apply their knowledge to business challenges through experience-fueled electives and class projects. Students benefit from the experience of their faculty, who are finance experts and business leaders who understand today's challenges because they've experienced them firsthand.

Students can apply to gain valuable experience performing equity research and portfolio management in a student-managed mutual fund, The 360 Huntington Fund. Students may earn 1 semester hour per semester up to three times by participating.

Through coursework or individually, students can earn Bloomberg Market Concepts and the Bloomberg Environmental Social Governance certifications and better understand how businesses operate in the global economy—and how they implement strategies to become better corporate citizens.
